decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC lie very close to the firm's core heat exchange knowledge, so its in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product.
The marine box cooler builds on established know-how and reportedly holds a major market share in water cooling, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and improve it.
The marine cooling unit draws on the firm's related cooling expertise and has a dedicated page, which suggests strategic commitment and good capacity to learn from market results.
The compact oil cooler is a natural extension of the existing exchanger portfolio, so it fits the firm's absorptive capacity despite only modest website visibility.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology the firm understands deeply and can improve through ongoing R&D and service learning.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's engineering and R&D base, including EU research experience, which makes continued development likely.
